name: Fontaines D.C.

whyMatters.en: Dublin post-punk band; Dogrel (2019) onward put Irish place-name lyric and dry, driving guitars on late-2010s/2020s indie festival stages.
whyMatters.zh: 都柏林后朋克；自 Dogrel（2019）起把爱尔兰地名歌词与干、驱动的吉他送上 2010 末/2020 年代 indie 音乐节舞台。

interviewQuotes.text: We're a rock band from Dublin. That's enough.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Grian Chatten

lyricQuotes: I was started in the better land

shortBio.en: Chatten-fronted post-punk; Boys in the Better Land is the early statement.
shortBio.zh: Chatten 领衔的后朋克；Boys in the Better Land 是早期声明。

body.en:
Formed 2017. Dogrel and A Hero’s Death establish Chatten’s spoken-sung Dublin diction, twin guitars, and taut rhythm section; later albums (Skinty Fia, Romance) widen dynamics and production.

Boys in the Better Land (2019) and Jackie Down the Line / Starburster show early drive and later single craft.
body.zh:
2017 年组建。Dogrel 与 A Hero’s Death 确立 Chatten 半说唱都柏林吐字、双吉他与紧绷节奏组；后期专辑（Skinty Fia、Romance）拓宽动态与制作。

Boys in the Better Land（2019）与 Jackie Down the Line / Starburster 展示早期驱动与后期单曲工艺。

title.zh: 音乐节舞台上的地名后朋克

body.en:
Fontaines DC matter as a 2010s/20s UK/Irish post-punk wave node: literary local detail, dry production, high live work rate.

Not revival cosplay—current touring grammar.
body.zh:
Fontaines DC 要紧处是 2010/20 年代英爱后朋克浪潮节点：文学地方细节、干制作、高现场工作量。

不是复古扮相——是当下巡演语法。

title.en: Boys in the Better Land: debut drive
title.zh: Boys in the Better Land：出道驱动

body.en:
Fast tempo, place lyric, gang energy—Dogrel-era statement.

Entry to the early sound.
body.zh:
快速度、地名歌词、群体能量——Dogrel 时期声明。

早期声音入口。

title.en: Jackie Down the Line: later single craft
title.zh: Jackie Down the Line：后期单曲工艺

body.en:
Wider dynamics, clearer hook writing—post-Dogrel chart/festival reach.

Shows growth without abandoning diction.
body.zh:
更宽动态、更清晰钩子写作——Dogrel 之后的榜单/音乐节触达。

展示成长且不放弃吐字。

title.zh: 英语 indie 里的爱尔兰吐字

body.en:
Peers in UK post-punk cite the permission to keep local accent and reportage lyric.

DNA is voice + tempo discipline.
body.zh:
英国后朋克同辈引用保留地方口音与报道歌词的许可。

DNA 是声线 + 速度纪律。

title.en: Band on work rate and place

body.en:
Interviews often stress Dublin/Ireland specificity and touring density.

Useful sociology beside the records.
body.zh:
访谈常强调都柏林/爱尔兰具体性与巡演密度。

唱片旁的有用社会学。

note.zh: Post-punk 节奏配都柏林纪实。

note.en: Proof the post-punk wire still carries current.
note.zh: 证明 post-punk 的线仍有电流。
